intro.text: The point above each of the twelve seas where a constant fall of aether spores streams down from one of the moons, which hang fixed in the sky.

description.text: Sailors usually give lunagrees a wide berth, since spores in the air near them are dangerous.
The Verdant Lunagree, some fifty or sixty miles from Diggen's Point, supplies the verdant spores that form the Emerald Sea.
Lunagrees are bright and colourful. The sea stands higher beneath each one, so a ship sailing close finds itself climbing a slope.
The lair of Xisis lies near the Crimson Lunagree; simply coming close to it is enough to be granted a meeting.
